title: Home Inspection VS. Appraisal
description:
🏡 Home Inspection Vs. Appraisal: What's the Difference?

As a home buyer, you'll likely include two contingencies in your offer: a home inspection and an appraisal. So, what sets them apart?

A home inspection gives you insight into the safety and condition of the home, allowing you to negotiate any needed repairs. On the other hand, an appraisal, usually requested by your lender, determines the home's value based on comparable properties to ensure you're not overpaying. Both are crucial in making an informed purchase.

For more details on these processes and how they benefit you, reach out to my team and me. We’re here to guide you every step of the way.
